name: dsh-game-boy
description: DSH 游戏中心：以 GitHub/Gitee Issue 为目录、独立 Git 仓库分发游戏、由游戏中心统一提供模型/存档/生命周期的 DSH 插件集合。

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/protocol run build && pnpm -r --filter=!@dsh-gamecenter/protocol --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/protocol run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter=!@dsh-gamecenter/protocol --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/protocol run test && pnpm -r --filter=!@dsh-gamecenter/protocol --if-present run test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/protocol run test && pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/catalog run test && pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/host run test && pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/client run test
scripts.build:staging: pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/protocol run build && pnpm -C packages/dsh-gamecenter exec tsc -p tsconfig.staging.json
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:staging && pnpm --filter @dsh-gamecenter/catalog run build && pnpm -C tests/integration test
